rows.text: Allotment Of 78,11,100 Fully Convertible Equity Warrants On A Preferential Basis.
allots a **second tranche of 73,50,700 warrants at Rs 12, about Rs 8.82 crore (our arithmetic)**, to two allottees, after 98,38,200 on 23 September - a new warrant issue.
